# Driver/Goal/Objective Catalog — S09 Documents and integrations (Phase A)

## Metadata

Type catalog; phase A; plateau psa; owner the programme architect (conveyor-e2e); reviewer the Architecture Board (conveyor-architecture-board); review date 2026-11-24; project 01a1d039-0d2d-71f1-a403-c9abe52c1888; retrospective under delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14.

## Entries

Nine driver, goal and objective rows: bytes out of Postgres into MinIO, secrets that never answer in plaintext, adjacent services reachable only as declared actions, an internal ingest action over the strata service, repositories as references, live report queries, read-only worker and billing displays, the x-secret projection and the guarded purge.

## Links

Derives from the slice plan sections 1, 3, 5, 8 and the ten decisions closed in section 9; realizes the Phase A driver view; reuses the S03 tenancy and trace_link and the S04 action registry and served spec.

## Document

The artefact sits under the slice plan and the project's architecture set. The plan records that Part A and Part B were built on 2026-11-08; the pre-rework audit pack docs/evidence/rework/S09.json still records verdict red because the governance record and gate run were absent, and this catalogue records the intent rather than claiming the gate passed.

entries.axis_a: D1 Bytes stored in Postgres TOAST every row and every dump
entries.axis_b: G1 Bytes live in MinIO behind one authorized stream

value.objective: object_store writes bucket conveyor-documents at key t/<tenant>/<document>/<version>; every byte streams through /api/documents/{id}/content authenticated against tenant_id and membership; no presigned URL exists (plan 5.2, decision 1).

entries.axis_a: D2 A secret returned once for convenience is the whole leak
entries.axis_b: G2 Secrets are write-only and never revealed

value.objective: create and rotate take value marked x-secret; get and list return id, name, scope, key_id, version and created_at only; there is no reveal action and OpenAPI examples are stripped for marked fields (plan 5.4, traps 2 and 3).

entries.axis_a: D3 One direct read of a neighbour's database owns its schema and its outages
entries.axis_b: G3 Every adjacent service is a declared action

value.objective: a call absent from action_registry does not exist; action_registry.service names the backing service; reads carry a 5 s timeout and writes 30 s; the breaker is process-local and opens after five failures in 30 s (plan 5.1, decision 7).

entries.axis_a: D4 Ingestion could become a second local pipeline
entries.axis_b: G4 documents.ingest is an internal action over the strata service

value.objective: documents.ingest is registered once as kind internal and pushes multipart to strata_ingest POST /api/ingest/jobs with the tenant token sealed as strata_ingest.token; the returned jobs[0].job_id is stored in document.external_ref (plan 5.6, decision 10).

entries.axis_a: D5 Cloning repositories would make the conveyor a git host
entries.axis_b: G5 Repositories are references

value.objective: repository holds provider, url, default_branch, installation_ref and credential_secret_id; project_repository is the join with role; coding work is coding_jobs.create with repository_url and ref returning run.external_ref; no git crate may appear in the dependency tree (plan 5.3, decision 6).

entries.axis_a: D6 Rolled-up metrics drift from the operational tables
entries.axis_b: G6 Every report number is a live query

value.objective: reports are document rows of kind report carrying meta.params and meta.generated_at; each number is computed on demand from event, card, list, run, approval, approval_decision and delivery; project_metrics stays dropped (plan 5.5, decision 8).

entries.axis_a: D7 Worker scheduling and billing logic are other systems' authority
entries.axis_b: G7 Workers, billing and observability are read-only displays

value.objective: the workers page renders the external answer with no writes and no local table; billing.summary reads inference_call and tool_call and billing display adds app_licence as of checked_at with no arithmetic, metering write or budget mutation (plan 5.5, decision 9).

entries.axis_a: D8 A marked secret leaking into a published OpenAPI example
entries.axis_b: G8 The served spec strips marked examples and asserts

value.objective: utoipa and the MCP projection carry x-secret on the value field and publish no default or example for it; the served-spec lock is regenerated only through the binary's --print-openapi --write-lock and checked by --check-lock (build step 8, trap 3).

entries.axis_a: D9 A delete that drops the row and leaves the object
entries.axis_b: G9 Tombstone first, purge guarded by status

value.objective: documents.delete sets status deleted and enqueues document.purge; the purge checks status == deleted before removing bytes and clear_object_tx refuses a non-deleted row, so orphaned bytes and pointerless documents are both refused (plan 5.2, trap 0b).

entries.axis_b: A 1 MiB document keeps its bytes, hash and deletion

value.acceptance: upload 1 MiB, list and download: sha256 equals content_hash; delete yields GET 404 and object_store::head returns NotFound; documents_roundtrip asserts it and mc stat is only the manual cross-check (plan 7).

entries.axis_b: 10 MiB is the boundary and one byte more is refused

value.acceptance: 10,485,760 bytes accepted, 10,485,761 refused 413 application/problem+json with a stable type; documents_limits; the router's 16 MiB layer is an envelope and the action's cap remains the check (plan 7, trap 0).

entries.axis_b: Rotation returns no plaintext

value.acceptance: rotate to version 2; GET has no plaintext, no value key and no ciphertext; secrets_never_revealed; the envelope is HKDF-SHA256 per tenant with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and key_id kek:v1 (plan 5.4, 7).

entries.axis_b: The workers display is live and read-only

value.acceptance: the page renders live rows; a stopped service yields last-known values plus a banner and the breaker opens after five failures; externals_declared proves the declaration and the absence of writes (plan 7).

entries.axis_b: Every report number equals its SQL count

value.acceptance: each number in the report document equals its SQL count on the same snapshot; reports_match_sql; the five sources are event, card join list, run, approval, approval_decision and delivery (plan 5.5, 7).

entries.axis_b: Every external declares its timeout and only the executor calls out

value.acceptance: GET /api/actions shows timeout_ms on every external and zero reqwest:: usages outside the executor; externals_declared plus the registry and parity_http_mcp wire-shape tests (plan 7).

entries.axis_b: Billing is display only

value.acceptance: no write action and no metering event in the manifest; billing.summary reads inference_call and tool_call; the display adds app_licence status, expires_at and checked_at with no arithmetic (plan 5.5, 7).

entries.axis_b: 0013 owns the schema with FORCE RLS

value.acceptance: migrations/0013_documents.sql creates document, repository, project_repository and secret with their foreign keys, indexes and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; the server binary applies migration 0013 twice and the second run is a no-op (plan 6 step 2).

entries.axis_b: The one gap is named, not hidden

value.acceptance: the front matter lists 27 actions; 26 are registered through the S04 registry; documents.ingest is the single unregistered action because it needs a live strata_ingest target, and it is recorded as a follow-up with a live target rather than as proven code (plan 6).

entries.axis_b: Every mutation writes its outbox row in its transaction

value.acceptance: document.created/updated/deleted/ingested, repository.created/linked and secret.created/rotated/deleted are written one per mutation in the same transaction with the payload keys of plan 5.7; no event is emitted by a read path.

entries.axis_b: the repository standard with FORCE row-level security

value.usage: every S09 table carries tenant_id and ENABLE plus FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with the tenant policy; migration 0013 is applied by the server binary so the runtime grants are re-applied, and a second run is a no-op (plan 6 step 2)

entries.axis_b: actions only, unversioned routes

value.usage: every write is a registered action served at POST /api/actions/{name}/invocations; read routes are unversioned /api/<resource>; a call absent from action_registry does not exist (plan 5.1)

entries.axis_b: MinIO through object_store, never local disk or artifacts

value.usage: bucket conveyor-documents, key t/<tenant>/<document>/<version>; local disk rejected because bytes die with the pod; artifacts rejected because it is a second authorizer; no presigned URL (plan 5.2)

entries.axis_b: HKDF-SHA256 and XChaCha20-Poly1305

value.usage: 32-byte KEK from CONVEYOR_SECRET_KEK in the pod environment only; per-tenant key HKDF(KEK, salt tenant_id); ciphertext nonce plus ct plus tag; key_id kek:v1; rotation bumps version and discards the old ciphertext (plan 5.4)

entries.axis_b: x-secret in OpenAPI and MCP

value.usage: value is marked x-secret on create and rotate; the served spec carries no default or example for it; the lock is written only by --print-openapi --write-lock and checked by --check-lock (build step 8, trap 3)

entries.axis_b: declared action, timeout and process-local breaker

value.usage: 5 s read timeout and 30 s write; the breaker opens after five failures in 30 s; reqwest:: appears only inside the executor; every external row names action_registry.service (plan 5.1)

entries.axis_b: live SQL, no rollup table

value.usage: each number is a query on event, card, list, run, approval, approval_decision or delivery; reports are document rows of kind report with meta.params and meta.generated_at; project_metrics stays dropped (plan 5.5)

entries.axis_b: no worker manager, billing engine or KAG

value.usage: workers, billing and observability are read-only displays; billing writes and metering events are absent from the manifest; KAG is archived and has no client, asset_bindings or card_asset_binding (plan 5.1, 5.5)

entries.axis_b: sniff, allowlist and attachment disposition

value.usage: the allowlist is pdf, text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv, json, png, jpeg and svg; magic bytes must match the declared type; application/octet-stream is refused; bytes are served as attachment with nosniff (plan 5.2, trap 6)

entries.axis_b: the plan gate on the hosted preflight for the compile verdict

value.usage: the gate runs fmt, clippy, the served-spec lock, migrate twice, and the named test targets; the compile and test verdict comes from the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight, and port 8000 is never used (plan 7)

entries.axis_a: D1 Bytes stored in Postgres TOAST every row and every dump
entries.axis_b: G1 Bytes live in MinIO behind one authorized stream

value.objective: object_store writes bucket conveyor-documents at key t/<tenant>/<document>/<version>; every byte streams through /api/documents/{id}/content authenticated against tenant_id and membership; no presigned URL exists (plan 5.2, decision 1).

entries.axis_a: D2 A secret returned once for convenience is the whole leak
entries.axis_b: G2 Secrets are write-only and never revealed

value.objective: create and rotate take value marked x-secret; get and list return id, name, scope, key_id, version and created_at only; there is no reveal action and OpenAPI examples are stripped for marked fields (plan 5.4, traps 2 and 3).

entries.axis_a: D3 One direct read of a neighbour's database owns its schema and its outages
entries.axis_b: G3 Every adjacent service is a declared action

value.objective: a call absent from action_registry does not exist; action_registry.service names the backing service; reads carry a 5 s timeout and writes 30 s; the breaker is process-local and opens after five failures in 30 s (plan 5.1, decision 7).

entries.axis_a: D4 Ingestion could become a second local pipeline
entries.axis_b: G4 documents.ingest is an internal action over the strata service

value.objective: documents.ingest is registered once as kind internal and pushes multipart to strata_ingest POST /api/ingest/jobs with the tenant token sealed as strata_ingest.token; the returned jobs[0].job_id is stored in document.external_ref (plan 5.6, decision 10).

entries.axis_a: D5 Cloning repositories would make the conveyor a git host
entries.axis_b: G5 Repositories are references

value.objective: repository holds provider, url, default_branch, installation_ref and credential_secret_id; project_repository is the join with role; coding work is coding_jobs.create with repository_url and ref returning run.external_ref; no git crate may appear in the dependency tree (plan 5.3, decision 6).

entries.axis_a: D6 Rolled-up metrics drift from the operational tables
entries.axis_b: G6 Every report number is a live query

entries.axis_a: D7 Worker scheduling and billing logic are other systems' authority
entries.axis_b: G7 Workers, billing and observability are read-only displays

value.objective: the workers page renders the external answer with no writes and no local table; billing.summary reads inference_call and tool_call and billing display adds app_licence as of checked_at with no arithmetic, metering write or budget mutation (plan 5.5, decision 9).

entries.axis_a: D8 A marked secret leaking into a published OpenAPI example
entries.axis_b: G8 The served spec strips marked examples and asserts

value.objective: utoipa and the MCP projection carry x-secret on the value field and publish no default or example for it; the served-spec lock is regenerated only through the binary's --print-openapi --write-lock and checked by --check-lock (build step 8, trap 3).

entries.axis_a: D9 A delete that drops the row and leaves the object
entries.axis_b: G9 Tombstone first, purge guarded by status

entries.axis_b: the repository standard with FORCE row-level security

value.usage: every S09 table carries tenant_id and ENABLE plus FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with the tenant policy; migration 0013 is applied by the server binary so the runtime grants are re-applied, and a second run is a no-op (plan 6 step 2)

entries.axis_b: actions only, unversioned routes

value.usage: every write is a registered action served at POST /api/actions/{name}/invocations; read routes are unversioned /api/<resource>; a call absent from action_registry does not exist (plan 5.1)

entries.axis_b: MinIO through object_store, never local disk or artifacts

value.usage: bucket conveyor-documents, key t/<tenant>/<document>/<version>; local disk rejected because bytes die with the pod; artifacts rejected because it is a second authorizer; no presigned URL (plan 5.2)

entries.axis_b: HKDF-SHA256 and XChaCha20-Poly1305

value.usage: 32-byte KEK from CONVEYOR_SECRET_KEK in the pod environment only; per-tenant key HKDF(KEK, salt tenant_id); ciphertext nonce plus ct plus tag; key_id kek:v1; rotation bumps version and discards the old ciphertext (plan 5.4)

entries.axis_b: x-secret in OpenAPI and MCP

value.usage: value is marked x-secret on create and rotate; the served spec carries no default or example for it; the lock is written only by --print-openapi --write-lock and checked by --check-lock (build step 8, trap 3)

entries.axis_b: declared action, timeout and process-local breaker

value.usage: 5 s read timeout and 30 s write; the breaker opens after five failures in 30 s; reqwest:: appears only inside the executor; every external row names action_registry.service (plan 5.1)

entries.axis_b: live SQL, no rollup table

value.usage: each number is a query on event, card, list, run, approval, approval_decision or delivery; reports are document rows of kind report with meta.params and meta.generated_at; project_metrics stays dropped (plan 5.5)

entries.axis_b: no worker manager, billing engine or KAG

value.usage: workers, billing and observability are read-only displays; billing writes and metering events are absent from the manifest; KAG is archived and has no client, asset_bindings or card_asset_binding (plan 5.1, 5.5)

entries.axis_b: sniff, allowlist and attachment disposition

value.usage: the allowlist is pdf, text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv, json, png, jpeg and svg; magic bytes must match the declared type; application/octet-stream is refused; bytes are served as attachment with nosniff (plan 5.2, trap 6)

entries.axis_b: the plan gate on the hosted preflight for the compile verdict

value.usage: the gate runs fmt, clippy, the served-spec lock, migrate twice, and the named test targets; the compile and test verdict comes from the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight, and port 8000 is never used (plan 7)
